reviews.title: If You Are Precise in Measuring Your Ingredients, This Is Not the One
reviews.text:
I’m guessing if you just want to scan food and take it as is, or scan barcodes, this app is fine. But things like the voice input are not great usability. 

Sometimes automating everything is not ACTUALLY more convenient. If I am logging by ingredient weight in a recipe, there is no way to go back and edit either. 

So it turns into a giant pain to be able to log actual gram weights in a recipe. 

This is especially painful by voice. Because there is no way to manually enter things after you have weighed them. 

The timeout on the voice function is just too short, with no override. And then you cannot go back and edit. Very user-unfriendly.

I didn’t have it long enough to know whether simple scans would work fairly well, so if that’s what you do primarily, it may work great for you. 

Anyone measuring out ingredients, though, not a good option.

reviews.title: The best!
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app all summer and it has completely blown me away! All I do is take a picture of everything I eat and drink and it’s automatically logged with correct weights/portions and macros!!! I’ve also added a couple recipes so I can just quickly log my meal prep. And I’m sure there are still some cool tricks and perks I haven’t even discovered yet….wouldn’t trade this app for the world, truly. 10/10
